538:t_1:4.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Martial prowess is the harmony of all things. Battle is peace...」

538:t_1:5.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Devout apostles of $$マーティアル$$! As Pope, I promise you eternity in God's name!」

538:t_1:6.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Divine punishment will one day fall upon $$サイデリアル$$ and all who oppose our God...」

538:t_1:7.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「We are the ones... who will overcome the future of despair!」

538:t_1:8.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
(Come, $$触れ得ざる者$$, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$. If you defy God's will again, this time you will offer up your life.)

538:t_1:9.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
(You are not the one God favors! It is I... Pope $$ヴィアチェスラフ・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$!)

538:t_1:10.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
($$キリコ・キュービィー$$... He is one of the greatest mysteries in the $$アストラギウス$$ Galaxy... no, in this universe.)

538:t_1:11.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
(Even $$ワイズマン#pilot$$, once the god of $$アストラギウス$$, who ruled 3,000 years of galactic history, could not control him...)

538:t_1:12.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
(There are many names for him: a born $$ＰＳ$$, an $$異能生存体$$, the $$触れ得ざる者$$...)

538:t_1:13.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
(All of them describe him, and yet none of them do...)

538:t_1:17.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

538:t_1:18.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「There is a god in the holy city of $$アレギウム$$...」

538:t_1:19.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「That is what $$キリコ$$ says.」

538:t_1:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「So that is what $$キリコ$$ sensed when he touched the collective unconscious.」

538:t_1:22.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Then the $$マーティアル$$ forces appearing there must have some connection to it too.」

538:t_1:23.en:
$$マオ$$
「So while the $$ダナン$$ distracts the Empire, we go to $$アレギウム$$ and gather information on this god.」

538:t_1:24.en:
$$クルツ$$
「It looks like we'll have a pretty austere mission, touring temples and shrines.」

538:t_1:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit complaining. It seems that future of despair has something to do with beings called gods.」

538:t_1:26.en:
$n
「It's true we've been fighting people who call themselves gods since the $$時獄戦役$$, but...」

538:t_1:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「But when it comes to actually gathering information on one, I have no idea where to start.」

538:t_1:28.en:
$$アルト$$
「But $$アレギウム$$ is 《$$マーティアル$$》's headquarters. It should be the perfect place to gather information on a god.」

538:t_1:33.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I belonged to the holy city of $$アレギウム$$'s defense force, but I have never met a being called God.」

538:t_1:34.en:
$n
「I think a god is usually the concept of an absolute being that people worship, without a physical form...」

538:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
「In the $$霧の海$$, $$ストライカー#pilot$$ tried to become that god.」

538:t_1:36.en:
$n
「In that case, it probably meant an actual supreme being, rather than a concept.」

538:t_1:37.en:
$n
「A god can also mean someone beyond humanity. In other words, a being greater than humans that guides them.」

538:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
「Then is that supreme being at the place we are heading to now?」

538:t_1:40.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I only said what I sensed.」

538:t_1:41.en:
$$キリコ$$
「But I am certain of it.」

538:t_1:45.en:
$$カレン$$
「I've known him a long time. Besides...」

538:t_1:46.en:
$n
「That was where he was with $$フィアナ$$ when she died...」

538:t_1:48.en:
$n
「I'm sorry. I didn't say that to blame you.」

538:t_1:49.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$テイタニア$$... $$フィアナ$$ died because her time was up. It wasn't anyone's fault.」

538:t_1:50.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「But as a $$マーティアル$$ soldier, I stole what little time she and $$キリコ$$ had left...」

538:t_1:51.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're making up for that by fighting alongside $$キリコ$$.」

538:t_1:52.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Even so... it still isn't enough.」

538:t_1:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Are you prepared to stake your life?」

538:t_1:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「But even so, $$キリコ$$ does not want you to die.」

538:t_1:58.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'm sorry. I feel a little more at ease now.」

538:t_1:59.en:
$$宗介$$
「Comrades need not thank each other.」

538:t_1:64.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Everyone's surprised. You actually comforted someone.」

538:t_1:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「I cannot tell myself, but it seems so.」

538:t_1:67.en:
$n
「You're still pretty much the quiet type, though.」

538:t_1:68.en:
$$宗介$$
「You are the last person I want to hear that from.」

538:t_1:69.en:
$$アルト$$
(By admitting his feelings for $$かなめ$$, $$宗介$$ can probably understand $$キリコ$$'s battles and the feelings of those around him now.)

538:t_1:70.en:
$$カレン$$
(He's changed so much since the start of the $$時獄戦役$$.)

538:t_1:71.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But you guys sure don't care if you live or die. You actually stormed $$アレギウム$$.」

538:t_1:72.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah. That mission gives me cold sweats even now.」

538:t_1:73.en:
$$レド$$
「Is this place called $$アレギウム$$ a heavily fortified stronghold?」

538:t_1:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「As its holy title suggests, it is lined with temples and other buildings. It is not a military facility.」

538:t_1:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's the people guarding it who are scary.」

538:t_1:76.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Their strength is one thing, but their morale is on a whole other level.」

538:t_1:78.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Back when I was still a soldier. I tried to infiltrate the place and got put through hell.」

538:t_1:79.en:
$$レド$$
「Why is their morale so high?」

538:t_1:80.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's the power of faith. They fight under God's will.」

538:t_1:81.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It gives them absolute confidence in what they do and wipes away all hesitation and doubt.」

538:t_1:82.en:
$$マオ$$
「I guess that's why they can fight the Empire independently of the $$地球連邦軍$$.」

538:t_1:83.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even $$サイデリアル$$ will have a hard time getting them to throw in the towel.」

538:t_1:84.en:
$$宗介$$
「Thanks to that, they apparently regained some of the authority they lost in the 《$$赫い霍乱$$》.」

538:t_1:85.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's who we're dealing with. If we end up fighting $$マーティアル$$ at $$アレギウム$$, it'll be a real pain.」

kept_omissions: 538:t_1:45: Kallen trails off after Besides; Hibiki supplies the painful memory in the next row.
